comparison.question: Bandingkan kekuatan dan risiko BUMI dengan BYAN

answer.title: Cost resilience comes with different exposures

summary.text: BYAN has a lower cash cost of 33.00 USD/ton against BUMI's 52.00 USD/ton, alongside a longer reserve life. These operating advantages should be assessed against destination concentration and license exposure before drawing a valuation conclusion.

findings.text: BYAN's unit margin is 52.00 USD/ton against BUMI's 10.00 USD/ton in the active dataset. This suggests a larger operating buffer at the supplied realized prices; it does not establish that every future price shock will affect the issuers equally.
findings.title: A stronger unit-cost buffer

findings.text: BYAN's reserve life is 25.71 years and BUMI's is 14.83 years. The measure holds annual production constant and cannot establish license renewal, future recovery, or the economics of extracting all remaining reserves.
findings.title: Reserve life needs an operating context

findings.text: BYAN's largest destination is China with 45.00% of sales volume; BUMI's largest-destination share is 30.00%. Concentration can increase sensitivity to a local demand reduction, but volume shares do not establish revenue exposure.
findings.title: Sales concentration can offset cost strength

findings.text: BUMI's linked licensed area expiring within the near-term window is 25.00%, compared with 12.00% for BYAN. These figures locate an exposure for research; they do not represent probabilities of failed renewal or site-level production losses.
findings.title: Expiry exposure needs renewal evidence

findings.text: The supplied RBV model capitalizes gross profit and excludes overhead, tax, capital expenditure, working capital, and the debt/cash bridge. A large modeled gap therefore requires reconciliation before it can support an equity-value interpretation.
findings.title: Modeled reserves are not equity value

findings.text: Compare the issuer reporting periods, realized prices, ownership scope, and renewal evidence. Then run a combined scenario with explicit assumptions rather than adding unrelated stress-test results.
findings.title: Reconcile periods and operating scope
